finite_theorem.name: P3146_T1_minimal_axiom_unit_action_measure_bridge
finite_theorem.statement: In the dimension basis (H,L,T), a unit-bearing 1D selector/action-measure bridge from dimensionless strict finite receivers requires independent length, time, and action scale inputs.  The finite audit over all 8 subsets of {A_cell,A_clock,A_action} shows that only the full triple spans length, time, action, and the minimal Lagrangian-density dimension H L^-1 T^-1.  Thus the axiomatic bridge is internally coherent but non-strict: it installs units only by three explicit postulates and exports no non-premise source law.
